reviews.text: A breath of fresh air. They actually return phone calls and show up on time. I called them as I was having trouble with my GFIs. They were at my home in less than 24 hours after calling.
reviews.author: Yves P.

reviews.text: Prompt, excellent work. Friendly and easy to work with. Never an issue with any service they provided. Quick response to a serious issue. I have used their services multiple times and will continue to do so.
reviews.author: Robbin C.

reviews.text: Excellent work by Central Penn Electric replacing our panel and running new circuit for a dishwasher & disposal in the kitchen. Great price, quality work, pleasant to deal with.
